label: Conspiracy that was TRUE

szenen.text: After World War Two, America secretly hired *Nazi scientists.*
Over *1,600* German scientists, engineers and technicians were brought to the U.S.
Many had been members of the *Nazi party.*
Their records were often *cleaned up* so they could get in.
One of them, *Wernher von Braun,* built rockets for Hitler.
Later, he led the team behind the *Saturn Five* rocket.
The rocket that took Americans *to the Moon.*
History is stranger than any theory. Follow for more.
